decisions.reason: As a core-range classic handle line, it still fits the firm's broad architectural hardware portfolio, but after several years a mature non-flagship design line faces some risk of portfolio rationalization or replacement.

This handle family remains close to the established business and helps cover different project requirements, so a large German supplier would usually retain it unless overlapping lines make consolidation attractive.

The electronic access system aligns directly with the firm's strategic move toward digital building organization and was presented as a flagship, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn absent a clear successor or technical problem.
